title: Comparative Federalism
modules: Devolution Of Powers And The Principle
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the Head of the Legislature."
The Prime Minister is the Head of the Legislature.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is composed of the Federal District; 26 states; and 5,561 municipalities."
The government is composed of the Federal District; 26 states; and 5,561 municipalities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the final arbiter in the interpretation of the Constitution and of division of powers."
The Supreme Court is the final arbiter in the interpretation of the Constitution and of division of powers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered one of the oldest inhabited places on earth."
The land is considered one of the oldest inhabited places on earth.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most diverse countries on the European continent."
Switzerland is one of the most diverse countries on the European continent.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the Federation's bicameral legislature, consisting of the Chamber of Deputies and the Federal Senate."
The National Congress is the Federation's bicameral legislature, consisting of the Chamber of Deputies and the Federal Senate.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a long term project of constitutional enactment, interpretation and enforcement committed to transforming a country's political and social institutions and power relationships in a given direction."

Transformative constitutionalism is a long term project of constitutional enactment, interpretation and enforcement committed to transforming a country's political and social institutions and power relationships in a given direction.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a reference to the ancient mythological emperor, whose story was told to have conquered the whole of the sub-continent of India and ruled the region in peace and harmony."
The name is a reference to the ancient mythological emperor, whose story was told to have conquered the whole of the sub-continent of India and ruled the region in peace and harmony.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a form of government in which representative democracy operates under the principles of liberalism, i.e. protecting the rights of the individual, which are generally enshrined in law."

Liberal democracy is a form of government in which representative democracy operates under the principles of liberalism, i.e. protecting the rights of the individual, which are generally enshrined in law.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the Head of the Executive."
The President is the Head of the Executive.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to strict compliance to the instructions provided by the constitution."
Constitutionalism on the other hand refers to strict compliance to the instructions provided by the constitution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are regarded as of equal importance by the constitution."
The four major languages are regarded as of equal importance by the constitution.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a form of government in which the ruling power of a state is largely vested not in any particular class or classes, but in the members of the community as a whole (Bryce, 1921)."
Democracy is a form of government in which the ruling power of a state is largely vested not in any particular class or classes, but in the members of the community as a whole (Bryce, 1921).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a check on both the Executive and the Legislature through judicial review."
The courts are a check on both the Executive and the Legislature through judicial review.
fib: ______ is composed of 26 states and the Federal capital district of Brasilia.
Brazil
Brazil is composed of 26 states and the Federal capital district of Brasilia.
______ means the fiscal arrangement existing among and between the various levels of government in Nigeria.
Fiscal federalism
Fiscal federalism means the fiscal arrangement existing among and between the various levels of government in Nigeria.
______ refers to the principles of tolerance and forbearance that make for fairness, equity and justice in the relationship among the various groups within a political entity.
Political accommodation
Political accommodation refers to the principles of tolerance and forbearance that make for fairness, equity and justice in the relationship among the various groups within a political entity.
______ is a country with the population of over 1 billion people, forming 1/7th of the world's population.
India
India is a country with the population of over 1 billion people, forming 1/7th of the world's population.
______ is a hodgepodge of linguistic, religious, social and cultural contrasts.
country
The country is a hodgepodge of linguistic, religious, social and cultural contrasts.
______ is responsible for giving direction to government policies and also charged with the implementation of those policies.
executive
The executive is responsible for giving direction to government policies and also charged with the implementation of those policies.
______ is made up of three hundred and sixty members, elected from various constituencies of nearly equal population as far as possible.
House of Representatives
The House of Representatives is made up of three hundred and sixty members, elected from various constituencies of nearly equal population as far as possible.
______ is an organisation of government in between unitary government and confederal government.
Federation in other words
Federation in other words is an organisation of government in between unitary government and confederal government.
______ is described as a transformative constitution.
Indian constitution
Indian constitution is described as a transformative constitution.
______ is a federation composed of 36 states, bound by one constitution with three tiers of government.
Nigeria
Nigeria is a federation composed of 36 states, bound by one constitution with three tiers of government.
______ is a series of legal, political and administrative relationship, established among units of governments and which possess varying degree of authority and jurisdictional autonomy.
inter-governmental relation

An inter-governmental relation is a series of legal, political and administrative relationship, established among units of governments and which possess varying degree of authority and jurisdictional autonomy.
______ is concerned with giving as much autonomy as possible to local communities and letting the differences between them co-exist peacefully and harmoniously.
Swiss federalism
The Swiss federalism is concerned with giving as much autonomy as possible to local communities and letting the differences between them co-exist peacefully and harmoniously.
______ is defined as the transfer of powers from central government to lower level governments in a political-administrative and territorial hierarchical format (Crook & Manor, 1998).
Decentralisation
Decentralisation is defined as the transfer of powers from central government to lower level governments in a political-administrative and territorial hierarchical format (Crook & Manor, 1998).
______ is one of the fundamental issues that can make or mar the development of a federal state.
power-sharing arrangement
The power-sharing arrangement is one of the fundamental issues that can make or mar the development of a federal state.
